integrity: Exact rational model reconstruction and outward-rounded complex intervals certify a local first Lyapunov coefficient sign. Reproduction requires SymPy and mpmath. This is an analytical local theorem using a standard nondegenerate Hopf theorem, not an externally audited certificate.
scientific_limitations: Local positive-equilibrium bifurcation only for fixed exact payoff matrices and beta=2; no global basin, no stability at K=1.7, no universally unique Hopf point, and no independent historical priority review.
title: An exact supercritical Hopf point in the predator-dependent replicator model
